description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class 'UpdateNpaConfig' which sets up batch processing jobs related to NPA updates, including job and step beans, and injects dependencies like database and security services.

classes.name: UpdateNpaConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines beans for the NPA update job, including job steps and tasklet, with dependencies injected via Autowired.

methods.name: updateNpaStep
methods.description: Creates and returns a Step object that executes the updateNpaTasklet within a transaction context.

methods.name: updateNpaJob

methods.name: updateNpaTasklet
